name: ramsey_n13_r4_s3__v4
prompt:
Find a 2-coloring of the edges of the complete graph K_13 such that there is no monochromatic red clique of size 4 and no monochromatic blue clique of size 3. Each edge is colored either 0 (red) or 1 (blue).

Return a list of 78 integers (0 or 1) representing the colors of edges listed in lexicographic order of (i,j) for i<j, or state "UNSATISFIABLE" if no such coloring exists.
